lessons.title: Words, pages and fine scrolling
lessons.file: I01 Words, pages and fine scrolling.md

steps.text: Jump from word to word with w and b
steps.hint: In NORMAL, w moves forward a word and b moves back

steps.text: Go down and up half a screen with ctrl+d and ctrl+u
steps.hint: ctrl+d goes down half a screen and ctrl+u goes up

steps.text: Move a screen forward and back with pgdn, ctrl+f, pgup
steps.hint: pgdn and ctrl+f go forward; pgup and ctrl+b go back

steps.text: Press v and select a few words
steps.hint: v enters VISUAL: the cursor stretches the selection

steps.text: Press V and select a whole line
steps.hint: V marks the full line, without picking columns

steps.text: With a selection, press y and paste it with p
steps.hint: y copies without deleting; p pastes after the cursor

steps.text: Select tide and press d: the text disappears
steps.hint: Write wind and tide on a line and delete only tide

steps.text: On a line, press yy
steps.hint: yy copies the whole line without deleting it

steps.text: Press p: the line appears twice in a row
steps.hint: p pastes below and the cursor moves down to the copy

steps.text: Press colon and leave it with Esc
steps.hint: The command line opens at the bottom, above the bar

steps.text: Run :w and see that it saves without leaving
steps.hint: Enter runs it; it only saves, the note stays open

steps.text: Run :e Trip: it opens the note Trip
steps.hint: First prepare the note Trip with a heading Packing

steps.text: Try :e Trip#Packing, :e Projects/Home and :e Beach
steps.hint: Beach doesn't exist: a draft with that name opens

steps.text: Insert /Toggle list and write a summary inside
steps.hint: It is a details block with a summary: it folds on click

steps.text: Insert /Callout
steps.hint: A callout is a quote that starts with [!NOTE]

steps.text: Write the TIP and WARNING callouts by hand
steps.hint: Two quotes: one with [!TIP] and another with [!WARNING]

steps.text: With the cursor in Trip, use /Page and save
steps.hint: The sub-note goes in the Trip folder; call it Beach packing

steps.text: In the explorer, press s on Trip and save
steps.hint: s creates a child note: save it as Day 1 inside Trip

steps.text: Insert /Table
steps.hint: It starts with two columns, its row of dashes and an empty row

steps.text: Fill two cells and move with Tab and Shift+Tab
steps.hint: Tab goes to the next cell; Shift+Tab goes back

steps.text: With the cursor inside, read the hint in the bar
steps.hint: Inside a table the bar reminds you of the cell keys

steps.text: Press / inside the table: its entries show up
steps.hint: The menu opens with the rows and columns at the top

steps.text: With the cursor in the table, run :addrow or :tr
steps.hint: Adds a row below the cursor's row

steps.text: Run :addcol or :tc: a column appears
steps.hint: The new column goes to the right of the current one

steps.text: Run :delrow: the table loses a row
steps.hint: The cursor's row goes away

steps.text: Run :delcol: every row loses a cell
steps.hint: The cursor's column goes away in every row

lessons.title: Tables: aligning as you type
lessons.file: I09 Tables, aligning as you type.md

steps.text: Run :tablefmt or :tf
steps.hint: Pads the cells so every bar lines up

steps.text: Type Beach inside a padded cell
steps.hint: While it fits, the closing bar doesn't move

steps.text: Look at the table with borders in the preview
steps.hint: The preview draws the table without the Markdown dashes

steps.text: Click a cell in the preview and type Beach
steps.hint: The click opens the cell; the text lands in the note

steps.text: Click + Add row and + Add column
steps.hint: Both buttons live under the table in the preview

steps.text: Click a column header and rename it
steps.hint: Call the second column Cost

steps.text: Insert /2 columns and write in both
steps.hint: The block starts with ~~~columns and separates with +++

steps.text: Insert /3 columns
steps.hint: Three columns carry two +++ separators

steps.text: Insert /4 columns
steps.hint: Four columns carry three +++ separators

steps.text: Look at the columns in the preview, narrow the window
steps.hint: When narrow, the columns stack one under the other

steps.text: Insert /Equation and write a^2 + b^2 = c^2
steps.hint: The block is called math and draws the formula in the preview

steps.text: Write by hand a block with two $$ lines
steps.hint: Between the two $$ lines put e^{i\pi} + 1 = 0

steps.text: Look at the two equations drawn in the preview
steps.hint: The preview writes them with symbols, nothing to install

steps.text: Insert /Board
steps.hint: It starts with three columns: Not started, In progress and Done

steps.text: Click + New page and write the card Backpack
steps.hint: + New page is at the bottom of each column

steps.text: Click the card: rename it to Boots
steps.hint: From the card you move it to another column and delete it

steps.text: Click a header and rename it to Finished
steps.hint: Clicking the header changes the whole column

steps.text: Insert /Calendar
steps.hint: The block keeps the month on the month line

steps.text: Click a day and write the event Beach
steps.hint: Each event is a line with the date and the text

steps.text: Click the event and rename it to Museum
steps.hint: From there you also move it to another day or delete it

steps.text: Click the Today header of the calendar
steps.hint: The header arrows change the month

steps.text: With the preview focused use < > and T
steps.hint: < and > move the month; T goes back to today

steps.text: Insert /Timeline
steps.hint: The block comes with two example spans

steps.text: Click + New and create the span Trip
steps.hint: Each span is Name: date -> date

steps.text: Click the span and rename it to Coast
steps.hint: You can also move it, stretch its dates or delete it

steps.text: Insert /Chart
steps.hint: The block says type: bar and comes with example values

steps.text: Click + Add value and add Beach: 3
steps.hint: Each value is a line Label: number

steps.text: Click a bar and rename it to Museum: 4
steps.hint: From the bar you edit the value or the label, or delete it

steps.text: Insert /Code and write echo hello
steps.hint: The line of code lives inside the fence

steps.text: Insert /Flowchart and write Start --> End
steps.hint: The arrow is the --> sign

steps.text: Look at the diagram drawn in the preview
steps.hint: The flow is drawn with boxes and arrows

steps.text: Insert /Image and pick an image from outside
steps.hint: It is copied to assets and leaves a line with ! and brackets

steps.text: Copy an image and use /Paste image or space i
steps.hint: It is pasted on its own line, starting with ![

steps.text: Look at the image drawn in the preview
steps.hint: If the terminal draws images you will see the thumbnail

steps.text: Check next to the note that the copy was made
steps.hint: The file lives in the vault's assets folder

steps.text: Insert /Video and pick a file
steps.hint: The link starts with the play sign

steps.text: Insert /Audio and pick a file
steps.hint: The link starts with the musical note

steps.text: Insert /File and pick a document
steps.hint: The link starts with the paperclip

steps.text: Type the start of a link and look at the headings
steps.hint: With two brackets and a hash only the headings show up

steps.text: Pick Packing: the link appears and gd jumps
steps.hint: The full link is written with brackets and a hash

steps.text: Type two brackets, Trip and a hash
steps.hint: You will see the headings of Trip, not those of this note

steps.text: Complete the link here and repeat it in Plan
steps.hint: Two links to the same heading: one in each note

steps.text: In Finder mode, look at the footer of the list
steps.hint: The footer reminds you: hash heading, caret block, Esc by hand

steps.text: At the end of a paragraph write ^booking
steps.hint: The caret and the name go at the end of the same line

steps.text: Write the link to the block in this note
steps.hint: Brackets, hash and caret before the name

steps.text: Link the block of Trip from here
steps.hint: First the block ^booking has to be in Trip

steps.text: Type the start and look at the list of blocks
steps.hint: Each block shows up with its text beside it

lessons.title: Aliases and the suggestion mode
lessons.file: I22 Aliases and the suggestion mode.md

steps.text: Write the link with a bar and my trip
steps.hint: The bar separates the target from the text you read

steps.text: In settings change Link suggestions and back
steps.hint: Try Finder and go back to Inline; the row saves at once

steps.text: In Finder type tag:travel and pick a note
steps.hint: In Inline, tag: is plain text inside the link

steps.text: Insert /Link to page and pick Trip
steps.hint: Writes a Markdown link with its path to the file

steps.text: Write the link to Trip by hand
steps.hint: The path of a file that exists goes in parentheses

steps.text: Write the web link with brackets and with angles
steps.hint: Both forms lead to https://example.com

steps.text: Jump to the next link with space o ]
steps.hint: space o [ goes to the previous link

steps.text: Write #travel in the body
steps.hint: The hash starts the tag; no spaces inside

steps.text: Write #travel/beach
steps.hint: The slash makes a tag inside another

steps.text: Add tags: beach, sun to the properties
steps.hint: Properties go at the top, between two lines of dashes

steps.text: Change it to tags: [beach, sun]
steps.hint: Square brackets are YAML's list form

steps.text: Change it to a list with beach and sun
steps.hint: One tag per line, with a dash in front

steps.text: Run :tags and pick a tag
steps.hint: The list gathers the vault's tags

steps.text: In the finder type tag:travel
steps.hint: tag: filters by tag, not by text

steps.text: In ctrl+p type #travel
steps.hint: In the normal finder the hash means a tag

steps.text: Search by name and by text with ctrl+p
steps.hint: The finder looks at the name and at the content too

steps.text: Check that the template doesn't show in :tags
steps.hint: Notes in Plantillas don't count for tags

steps.text: Press ? and filter by table
steps.hint: It also opens with space h; type table and look

steps.text: Run :settings from the palette
steps.hint: The palette runs any command without remembering the key

steps.text: Open a result in another tab with ctrl+t
steps.hint: In the finder, ctrl+t opens it without leaving this note

steps.text: Open :messages and read the latest messages
steps.hint: Each message carries its time

steps.text: See that the EXPORT entries come first
steps.hint: The palette puts what exports at the front

steps.text: Press space o d and save the daily note
steps.hint: It is saved in Diario with today's date as its name

steps.text: Create Plantillas/daily with two lines of text
steps.hint: The templates folder is Plantillas

steps.text: In another note insert /Template and pick daily
steps.hint: The template's text appears where the cursor is

steps.text: Add date and title to the template, insert it again
steps.hint: The double braces become the date and the name

steps.text: Put stage: new in the template and insert it
steps.hint: The note keeps stage: in progress and gains the new keys

steps.text: Open a folder with enter: its sibling closes
steps.hint: The accordion leaves one open folder per level

steps.text: In settings turn Accordion folders off and on
steps.hint: The row saves ui.accordion at once

steps.text: Create External note outside Misoku and wait
steps.hint: The tree refreshes on its own in a couple of seconds

steps.text: Move the preview with j k, d u, space, pgdn and G
steps.hint: With the preview focused, the wheel works too

steps.text: Fold with the triangle and zM; unfold with zR
steps.hint: zM closes every heading; zR opens them

steps.text: Create Trip to the coast with headings, a list, two tags
Add a three-column table: day, plan, cost
Link the total block of Budget
Add a board with a card in Pending
Go over everything in the reading view
